subject: Quick prioritization check — should we shelve the project?
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@fintechco.com>, Peter Stein <peter.stein@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jan 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery

Hi Emma / Peter —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

What we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and latency for your customer-facing recommendations service (p95 latency target ~120ms).
- Constraints: must run behind your VPC / customer data never leaves account; procurement will need SOC2 evidence.
- Timeline: aiming for pilot in Q1 if procurement can move.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached as "FintechCo-MAP-v1.xlsx"):
1) Trial environment: we provision a private dedicated node for a two-week pilot (Olga / Marcus to scope)
2) Security sign-off: provide SOC2 summary and audit contact (Vivek to send evidence)
3) Success criteria: token cost reduced >=30% or latency improvement to p95 <120ms

Ask: Can you confirm stakeholders and procurement contacts? If Q1 pilot is still realistic from your side, we'll lock in tentative dates.

Attachments: FintechCo-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft)

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@fintechco.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers:
- Stakeholders: me (ML), + Peter for platform, and procurement (cc: procurement@fintechco.com) — I'll introduce formally once we sign off the pilot scope.
- Procurement will need SOC2 + encryption in-transit/out-of-rest details. Can Vivek share a short packet?
- Q1 pilot: still hopeful but shrinking window — tentatively mid-Feb (team bandwidth permitting).

I'll review the MAP and get back with a procurement timeline by end of next week.

Thanks,
Emma
Head of ML | FintechCo
emma.liu@fintechco.com

Emma —

Following up on procurement timeline and stakeholder intros. Vivek attached a short SOC2 summary and an ROI note ("redwood-mamp-ROI.pdf"). Hoping that helps speed review.

If it helps, we can set a 20-minute call with your procurement and our compliance lead (Vivek) to walk through requirements and redlines — many SOC2 items are standard and we can point to encryption/KMS options for private deployments.

Proposed short slots: next Tue/Wed 10–11am PT. Do any work for Peter or procurement?

Thanks,
Olga

Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Checking status — does mid-Feb still look attainable?

Hi Emma —

Wanted to bump this thread as we haven't heard back after the MAP and SOC2 packet. Realizing priorities shift quickly — can you share whether the mid-Feb pilot is still on the table or if procurement bandwidth has pushed this out?

Two quick options we can offer if timelines are tight:
- Option A: Short technical proof-of-concept this month to validate latency/cost without procurement sign-off (non-production, limited access).
- Option B: Pause scheduling and reconvene next quarter when procurement capacity opens (we'll keep the MAP active).

If neither fit, a one-line update is perfect so we can adjust from our side.

Regards,
Olga

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@fintechco.com>
Cc: Peter Stein <peter.stein@fintechco.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Closing the loop — should I close the file?

Hi Emma —

Since I haven't heard back, I wanted to close the loop. Totally understand if this isn't a priority right now. Do you want me to: 

1) Close the file and we archive the MAP (we can re-open when you're ready), or
2) Keep the opportunity active with a tentative note for re-engagement in Q2 (we'll check in then).

If closing is best, I'll mark the deal as paused in HubSpot and remove calendar holds. If you prefer we keep a placeholder, I'll schedule a short touch in April. Either way, a one-line reply is all I need.

Thanks for the consideration — appreciate the time you and the team gave earlier.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
